notes.title: Demo Patch #6 Hotfix
notes.content: [list][*][p]Tooltips were being destroyed on inventory updates, and shouldn't be any longer[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch #6
notes.content: [list][*][p]Volume refreshes more frequently on the main screen[/p][/*][*][p]Commits and upgrades have been redone and hopefully fixes the negative major/minor/patches bug[/p][/*][*][p]Processes sometimes had bad weights/volumes[/p][/*][*][p]Fleet assembly now properly disables itself when there is no room in either the fleet or storage for the new ship[/p][/*][*][p]Fleet assembly also can send the new ship to storage if fleet is full but storage is not[/p][/*][*][p]Ore B is now visible/usable[/p][/*][*][p]All items have their economic value shown, and this the total is reflected in the upgrades screen for more clarity on how upgrade commits get earned[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch #5
notes.content: [list][*][p]Abandoning battles due to deadlock or any reason is now possible. Upon abandoning, any active ships are considered lost[/p][/*][*][p]Process Priorities now has a simple copy/paste system to rapidly change process priorities[/p][/*][*][p]Smelting maximum time tool tip was updated to reflect its actual changes, along with changes in calculations to give it an actual change in resource return rate[/p][/*][*][p]Redeploys and their associated colors have been changed to conform to the rest of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Process upgrades now have a 5x and 10x multiplier at the bottom to save your fingers from clicking too much[/p][/*][*][p]Mining minimum time has been updated to reflect what it says in the tooltip[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch #4
notes.content: [list][*][p]Transfer crash bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Process upgrade tool tips now show the current level[/p][/*][*][p]Ships can now be destroyed in the fleet menu[/p][/*][*][p]Ship levels are now more prominently displayed in the fleet menu[/p][/*][*][p]Two new help files have been added to explain combat mechanics a bit better'[/p][/*][*][p]"Collect Equipment" has been renamed to "Collect one" in the manufacturing tab[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content: [list][*][p]"Resets" have been changed to having the same language as "redeploy"[/p][/*][*][p]Help file colors were inconsistent and needed standardization[/p][/*][*][p]Two new help files on site quality and how mining quality and stability work[/p][/*][*][p]Neural network output nodes (the far right nodes) now show their bonuses when hovered and bonuses have been rolled[/p][/*][*][p]Minor achievement fixes - loaded/unloading distances have been adjusted and fixed and your volume maxes should have a multiplier now[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting menu shows current inventory of proposed crafting cost[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]One of the most consistent pieces of feedback we've received is how challenging it is to get the game to run on different screens, and by extension, the readability of the text. Given it's almost an entirely text driven game, it felt appropriate to make the following changes:
[/p][list][*][p]Display resolution has been added to the options menu. It has 4 of the most popular resolutions. Keep in mind the game assets themselves will be upscaled or downscaled.[/p][/*][*][p]Display mode has been added to the options menu. It has the basic options such as Windowed, Maximized, Full Screen, and Exclusive Full Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Two new fonts have been added, going off of other titles' choices[/p][/*][*][p]Fonts now have a size setting. Unfortunately this did require changing all text in the game, so there might be too much uniformity in font size moving forward [/p][/*][*][p]The options menu has had a nice little revamp to go with these new options[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're going back to a bug fixing and QoL schedule after this, though if any problems arise, please let us known on our [url="https://discord.gg/WPHvenvGeV"]discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch #1 Reverted
notes.content:
Unfortunately I found a configuration bug, and need to spend a little bit of time fixing it.

For now, we're going back to Demo build #1. I should have a fix and patch #1 up tonight.

Sorry, and thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a null reference error for processes on loading a save game
[*] Updated the crafting costs for additives/patterns to be monotonic
[*] Shields now start with a 5 second delay in regen, lowerable with the "seconds to shield regen" modifier
[*] Process upgrades now properly disable themselves if they're not yet unlocked for that process
[*] Redeploy upgrades always cost at least one commit, whether it is major, minor, or patch
[*] Fixed a bug with changing craft bases that had leftover costs from previously selected additives/patterns
[/list]

notes.title: Playtesting has begun!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The playtesting build is now released. It contains about 1/3rd of the content of the full game and should take 2 - 3 hours of active play before being hard stuck due to enemy difficulty.

The playtesting window will close [b]May 10th[/b]. I anticipate I will need at least a week to update the game based off of feedback before going straight into the public release of the Demo sometime around late May.

Please join the [url=https://discord.gg/Hm9Pq4fv]discord[/url]! All bug reports and requests will be handled there.

Thanks for playtesting!

notes.title: Playtesting Event starts soon! Help steer the game's direction!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are nearing the end of the stabilization phase of the game. It is time for intensive game feedback, as almost all systems in the game have been implemented with about 3/4ths of the content hidden/restricted (more items, levels, narratives, etc.).

This playtesting window is to answer the question of [b]how can we make the core gameplay loop more fun?[/b]

In addition to that, the playtest is to check the windows builds of the game and that they install/perform correctly.

We'd love to hear from you on our [url=https://discord.gg/WPHvenvGeV]discord[/url]!
